scope: Additive Locked decisions. All previous Locked decisions preserved.

decisions.decision: Every admitted user may rename any of their own setups. Preserve equipment history and shot provenance.

The last explicitly logged Slow Feed choice persists per setup across cloud sessions. Standard Feed makes the next default off; offline stale uploads cannot undo newer selections; unknown historical feed remains unknown. Preference is recorded on the active setup version.

Edit is the primary left action; Make Current Recipe is a separate right action. Eligible Dialed In shots automatically refine their family window; Make Current explicitly chooses a preferred family/example.
Use shot-card width and height efficiently to group measurements, setup, basket dose, feed, style, date and badges above sensory detail without crowding.
Manual export and import remain available under a collapsed Recovery options section in Settings; cloud sync and automatic offsite backups are the normal behavior.

decisions.topic: Automatic publishing and multi-system revision consistency
decisions.decision: After the user-approved development changes pass required tests and safety checks, promptly publish them to the existing SSO-protected owner Netlify site, without a separate per-change approval request. Keep GitHub implementation, applied Supabase migrations, Netlify deployed commit, and specification/decision ledger consistent; verify the published deploy. When publishing is blocked, disclose the blocker and request only the smallest required user action, never claim it is live.
decisions.safeguards: Preserve all other Locked decisions: SSO access, beta admission, import recovery gate, database RLS and data integrity, private production constraints, and original local prototype. Automated publication is for owner development, not authorization to launch external beta or apply unrelated migrations. A failed deploy never replaces the currently published site.
